title: Five-Job Checkers

use_case.body: A known checkers game made into an architectural portrait of the Workshop's five jobs. It turns one person's request into this exact plaything instead of decorating a generic download.
use_case.label: Made from your wish

wish: I wish our five-job Workshop became a checkers set for late-night design reviews—black and warm gold, architectural rather than cute.
